info.title: DQL API
info.description: DQL is an API to query entities in the Knowledge Graph

get.description: Search the Knowledge Graph using DQL

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Query type

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: DQL Query

parameters.name: col
parameters.description: Comma-delimited list of custom crawl collections to query. Specify `all` to query all collections for your token. This parameter is valid only when type=crawl and defaults to `all`

parameters.name: from
parameters.description:
Return results starting at `from` index. `from+size <= 10_000` for facet queries.

Please note that the from parameter is no longer applicable to Article queries and has been deprecated. In the future, using this parameter will result in an error.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return. `-1` to return all results. `from+size <= 10_000` for facet queries.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Output format

parameters.name: exportspec
parameters.description:
The spec defines the columns to export. This is applicable for csv, xls and xslx formats.

Export spec specifies how to export the entity JSON to a csv. A simple export spec looks like `name;summary`. To specify more complex export spec, including specifying how many of a list of `industries` to return, or the ideal `employment` record, see [Exporting Columnar Format](https://docs.diffbot.com/reference/exporting-csv) and [JsonPath Filtering](https://docs.diffbot.com/docs/en/filtering-fields).

parameters.name: exportseparator
parameters.description: The export separator

parameters.name: exportfile
parameters.description: For export endpoint, The file name of the export file

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Semi-colon separated path filter to filter response json. You can use a simple dot notation `skills.name` or a JsonPath expression such as such as `$.name;$.locations.country.name`. For more advanced options, see [JsonPath Filtering](https://docs.diffbot.com/docs/en/kg-filtering) for syntax.

parameters.name: filterExclude
parameters.description: Semi-colon separated path filter to filter and exclude data from response json. You can use a simple dot notation `skills.name` or a JsonPath expression such as such as `$.name;$.locations.country.name`. For more advanced options, see [JsonPath Filtering](https://docs.diffbot.com/docs/en/kg-filtering) for syntax.

parameters.name: jsonmode
parameters.description: `extended` returns origin information for facts. `id` returns just the diffbotIds and origins.

parameters.name: nonCanonicalFacts
parameters.description: `nonCanonicalFacts=true` returns non-canonical facts.

parameters.name: noDedupArticles
parameters.description: `noDedupArticles=true` indicates that articles should not be deduplicated but all of them returned

parameters.name: cluster
parameters.description:
Articles only. Utilize Diffbot clustering algorithms to identify related or similar objects.
- `cluster=all` to return each article with a clusterId identifying thematically-similar articles.
- `cluster=best` to remove thematically-similar articles from the result set, leaving a single best representative from each cluster.

- `cluster=dedupe` to remove exact and near-duplicate articles from the result set. Where applicable, clusterId is returned in the `entity_ctx` element of each response entity.

parameters.name: report
parameters.description: Generate coverage report. See [dql-coverage-reports](Coverage Reports) for more details on generating coverage reports for DQL queries.
